newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Air France starts Nigeria oil city flight.
newsitem.headline: Air France starts Nigeria oil city flight.

text.p: Air France has begun a weekly flight from Paris to the southeastern Nigerian oil city of Port Harcourt, aviation minister Air Commodore Ita Udo-Imeh said.
State radio reported that Udo-Imeh announced this in the capital Abuja on Wednesday while addressing reporters on an air services agreement between Nigeria and France.
Port Harcourt is the centre of Nigeria's vast oil industry and the minister said the flights, which commenced on January 21, meant passengers from there did not have to travel to Lagos to fly abroad.
Air France already operates a twice-weekly flight to Lagos from Paris on Mondays and Fridays. The Port Harcourt flight is on Tuesday, an airline official said.
